Markets.title: Gold rallies past three-month high as Treasury buyback and weak dollar boost demand
Markets.summary: Gold prices hit a three-month high on Monday due to a weaker U.S. dollar and a Treasury buyback. The rally was further driven by technical buying and strong exchange-traded fund inflows.

Markets.title: Sebi drops proceedings against Max Financial, Axis Bank in Max Life deal case
Markets.summary: Markets regulator Sebi has dropped proceedings against Max Financial and Axis entities regarding disclosure lapses and fraud allegations. The investigation found no evidence of a fraudulent scheme in transactions involving Max Financial, Max Life, and Axis Bank.

Markets.title: India's house price growth slows to 3.6% in Q1 FY27: RBI
Markets.summary: India's annual house price growth slowed to 3.6% in the first quarter of fiscal year 2027, down from 4.5% in the previous quarter. Despite this annual deceleration, the All-India House Price Index rose 1.1% from the prior quarter, driven largely by Chandigarh and Lucknow.

Markets.title: SoftBank pares nearly 2.6% stake in Lenskart for Rs 2,888 crore
Markets.summary: SoftBank Group sold a 2.6% stake in Lenskart for Rs 2,888 crore through a block deal involving multiple institutional investors. This transaction reduced SoftBank's holding in the company from 9.86% to 7.28%.

Markets.title: Ahead of Market: 10 things that will decide stock market action on Tuesday
Markets.summary: Indian equities closed lower on Monday, driven by rising bond yields, Iran sanctions uncertainty, and weak Asian markets. Analysts expect market volatility to continue on Tuesday as investors monitor these economic pressures.

Markets.title: Market Trading Guide: Siemens among 2 stock recommendations for Tuesday
Markets.summary: Indian equities remained weak and large caps faced pressure as bond yields rose, though metals outperformed. Analysts recommended buying Siemens and Engineers India due to strong technical breakouts and positive momentum.

Geo-Political.title: Iran faces 'greatest financial offensive ever', says US treasury secretary
Geo-Political.summary: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent announced that the United States will cut all economic ties with Iran in a maximum-pressure financial campaign. He added that any nation partnering financially with Iran will also face international isolation.

Geo-Political.title: UK PM Burnham vows support for Ukraine despite 'outrageous threats' from Russia
Geo-Political.summary: UK Prime Minister Burnham has pledged continued support for Ukraine following Russian warnings of consequences over the reported use of British drones. Moscow had issued "outrageous threats" in response to Ukraine's military actions involving British-supplied equipment.

Geo-Political.title: Russia's second-biggest online retailer targeted in Ukrainian strikes
Geo-Political.summary: Overnight Ukrainian strikes targeted warehouses belonging to Ozon, Russia's second-biggest online retailer. The affected facilities are located across southern Russia, including in Dagestan and Krasnodar.

Geo-Political.title: Israel warns of 'forceful' response to kites flown from Gaza
Geo-Political.summary: Israel has warned of a forceful response after kites were flown from Gaza into Israeli border communities. Hamas stated that children in Gaza launched the kites.

Geo-Political.title: King of Norway's health has worsened, palace says
Geo-Political.summary: Norway's King Harald remains hospitalized for a bloodstream bacterial infection. The royal palace reported that his health has worsened.

Geo-Political.title: Outrage in Nepal over rape and murder of 3-year-old girl
Geo-Political.summary: Protests have erupted in Nepal following the rape and murder of a three-year-old girl. The victim was found dead last week, three days after she was reported missing.

AI & Tech.title: How I Get Free Traffic from ChatGPT in 2025 (AIO vs SEO)
AI & Tech.summary: An online course creator discovered their product was recommended as the top result when asking ChatGPT for the best WordPress SaaS building course. The author achieved this recommendation without paying for advertising or traditional search engine optimization.

AI & Tech.summary: The digital landscape in 2025 requires content creators to use artificial intelligence to stay ahead of the competition. This guide outlines the top ten AI tools designed to simplify and revolutionize the content creation process.

AI & Tech.summary: LimeWire has transformed from a file-sharing service into a generative AI platform for content creation. The platform allows users to generate, share, and monetize their AI-created content.

AI & Tech.summary: This article explores ten of the most advanced and widely used artificial intelligence tools in 2023. These tools are designed to automate repetitive tasks, improve workflows, and increase productivity across various industries.

Data & Insights.title: Scott Bessent eying US Treasury cashpile, could use $1 trillion General Account for debt buybacks, says report
Data & Insights.summary: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent is reportedly considering using the department's $1 trillion General Account to fund buybacks of older, higher-yielding securities. This strategy, cited by two senior officials according to CNBC, aims to restructure government debt.

Data & Insights.title: India negotiating trade deals with nations, blocs worth $15 trillion GDP: Piyush Goyal
Data & Insights.summary: Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal stated that India is negotiating trade agreements with countries and blocs representing a combined GDP of $15 trillion. During his visit to Japan, Goyal is leading a business delegation of over 200 representatives to strengthen bilateral trade and investment.

Data & Insights.title: Iranian rial hits record low of 2.02 million against US dollar amid threat of new Trump sanctions — Here's what we know
Data & Insights.summary: On August 24, the Iranian rial fell 4.5% to a record low of 2.02 million against the US dollar. This currency drop occurred after US President Donald Trump announced plans for severe new economic sanctions against Tehran.

Data & Insights.title: Service producer prices index mixed in Q1; air passenger services surge 32%
Data & Insights.summary: Service producer prices were mixed in the first quarter with 2022-23 as the base year, while air passenger services surged by 32 percent. The government noted that aggregate weights are not assigned because the seven tracked services do not cover the entire sector.

Data & Insights.title: AI, semicon, global value chains: How globalization isn't dying—it's evolving
Data & Insights.summary: Global trade is shifting away from physical goods toward services and strategic technologies like semiconductors and artificial intelligence. Rather than disappearing, international supply chains and capital investments are simply transforming and reconfiguring.

Data & Insights.title: The week in charts: Hawkish RBI minutes, drought warning, rural workforce
Data & Insights.summary: This weekly data compilation highlights recent Mint reports featuring easy-to-read charts on key economic and environmental issues. The topics covered include hawkish Reserve Bank of India minutes, drought warnings, and trends in the rural workforce.

India.title: Fake Delhi Call Centre Offering Air India Job Busted, 3 Arrested
India.summary: Police arrested three people operating a fake call centre in Delhi that offered fraudulent Air India jobs. The scammers collected registration and employment fees from victims via UPI.

India.title: 0.1% Of Kumbh Budget Could Have Saved 125 Marathi Schools: Top Court Judge
India.summary: A Supreme Court judge stated that a tiny fraction of the Nashik Kumbh Mela budget could have prevented 100 to 125 Marathi-medium schools from shutting down. Justice PB Varale highlighted this funding disparity regarding the closure of these regional schools.

India.title: Ajit Doval In Beijing For 25th Round Of India-China Boundary Talks
India.summary: National Security Advisor Ajit Doval is in Beijing for the 25th round of India-China boundary talks. Bilateral relations have been severely strained since the 2020 Galwan Valley military clash.

India.title: Bihar Exam Officer's 'Dogs Bark' Remark For Protesters Triggers Row
India.summary: A Bihar exam official sparked controversy by comparing student protesters to barking dogs. Opposition leader Tejashwi Yadav visited the protest site to support the students and demanded an apology from the official.

India.title: 'Line That Cannot Be Crossed': Conrad Sangma's Warning On Shillong Violence
India.summary: Meghalaya Chief Minister Conrad Sangma condemned the recent violence in Shillong as very unfortunate. He warned that the government will take strict action against those responsible for spreading fear.

General.title: How the deadly A66 crash unfolded leaving seven dead
General.summary: At 03:30 BST on Saturday, a Volkswagen Passat collided with a marked police car on the A66 motorway. The crash resulted in seven deaths, including two police officers.

General.title: Burnham vows support for Ukraine despite 'outrageous threats' from Russia
General.summary: Andy Burnham has pledged his continued support for Ukraine following threats from Moscow. Russia warned of unspecified consequences after reports that Ukraine used British drones.

General.title: Is UK's Storm Shadow missile a game changer for Ukraine?
General.summary: BBC correspondent Joe Inwood analyzes the UK's Storm Shadow missile and its potential impact on the Russia-Ukraine war. The report examines whether this advanced weapons technology could significantly change the course of the conflict for Ukraine.

General.title: Snooker champion Graeme Dott guilty of child sex abuse
General.summary: Former world snooker champion Graeme Dott was found guilty of lewd and libidinous behavior towards a young girl and boy. The offenses constitute child sex abuse.

General.title: Prince Harry steps down from African wildlife charity board
General.summary: Prince Harry has resigned from the board of the African wildlife charity African Parks. His departure follows the organisation's admission last year that its rangers committed human rights abuses in Congo-Brazzaville.

General.title: World's oceans hit highest temperature on record as El Niño grows
General.summary: The world's oceans have reached their highest temperature on record. This trend is driven by growing environmental stress and the strengthening El Niño weather pattern.
